# Security & Identity Observability

**Security and identity observability**: live security alerts first, then identity risk, exposure, privileged access, lifecycle hygiene, change/RCA, expiring credentials, and finally Defender posture - the security lens on the same tenant the rest of the suite operates.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

parameters.name: LogAnalyticsWorkspaceId
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project value = id, label = name, selected = false | order by label asc

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "All", "label": "All", "selected": true}, {"value": "Production", "label": "Production", "selected": false}, {"value": "Pre-Production", "label": "Pre-Production", "selected": false}, {"value": "Development", "label": "Development", "selected": false}, {"value": "Test", "label": "Test", "selected": false}, {"value": "Sandbox", "label": "Sandbox", "selected": false}]

parameters.name: BusinessCriticality
parameters.label: Business criticality
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "All", "label": "All", "selected": true}, {"value": "Mission Critical", "label": "Mission Critical", "selected": false}, {"value": "Business Critical", "label": "Business Critical", "selected": false}, {"value": "High", "label": "High", "selected": false}, {"value": "Medium", "label": "Medium", "selected": false}, {"value": "Low", "label": "Low", "selected": false}]

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.label: Severity
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "All", "label": "All", "selected": true}, {"value": "Sev0 - Critical", "label": "Sev0 - Critical", "selected": false}, {"value": "Sev1 - High", "label": "Sev1 - High", "selected": false}, {"value": "Sev2 - Medium", "label": "Sev2 - Medium", "selected": false}, {"value": "Sev3 - Low", "label": "Sev3 - Low", "selected": false}, {"value": "Sev4 - Informational", "label": "Sev4 - Informational", "selected": false}]

content.json:
## Overview

Response-first security cockpit. Pick a tab to drill in; the **hero KPIs and 'Security posture at a glance' scorecard sit just below** and turn **red** on live signal. **Click any risky user, source IP, or resource row to pivot** - the sign-in, RBAC-change, stale-account, and credential tiles refilter to that entity for one-click investigation. Clear a pivot by reloading the page.

Tabs: **Threats** (active alerts) - **Identity** (risk) - **Exposure** - **Access** (privilege + credentials) - **Lifecycle** (stale accounts) - **Changes** (RCA) - **Posture** (Defender backlog).

## Active security alerts

Live Microsoft Defender for Cloud security alerts (active attacks / suspicious activity), newest first. Click a row to **pivot** the page to that resource; click **Open** to jump to its blade.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.severity),
         status = tostring(properties.status),
         alertName = tostring(properties.alertDisplayName),
         entity = tostring(properties.compromisedEntity),
         started = todatetime(properties.timeGeneratedUtc),
         resId = tostring(properties.resourceIdentifiers[0].azureResourceId)
| where status in ('Active','InProgress')
| where isempty('{SelectedResource}') or resId =~ '{SelectedResource}'
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project started, Severity = sev, Alert = alertName, Entity = entity,
           Subscription, ResourceId = resId
| order by started desc
| take 100
content.title: Active Defender alerts
content.noDataMessage: No active Defender for Cloud alerts in scope - either the tenant is quiet or Defender for Cloud alerting is not enabled on these subscriptions.

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, AlertSeverity, AlertName, CompromisedEntity, ProviderName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Sentinel alerts (if connected)
content.noDataMessage: No Microsoft Sentinel SecurityAlert rows - Sentinel is not connected to this workspace, or no alerts in the selected time range. (Defender alerts above are the primary source.)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status != 'Closed'
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, Title, Status, Owner = tostring(Owner)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Sentinel incidents (open)
content.noDataMessage: No open Sentinel incidents (or Sentinel is not connected to this workspace).

content.json:
## Identity risk

Risky sign-ins, password-spray campaigns, and legacy-auth logons - the live identity-attack signal. Click a risky user or source IP to **pivot** the page. Requires Entra ID logs (SigninLogs / AADUserRiskEvents) and Entra ID P1/P2.

content.query:
AADUserRiskEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by UserId, RiskEventType
| where RiskState in ('atRisk','confirmedCompromised')
| extend User = UserPrincipalName
| where isempty('{SelectedUser}') or User =~ '{SelectedUser}'
| where isempty('{SelectedIP}') or IpAddress =~ '{SelectedIP}'
| extend ['Open in Entra'] = strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_IAM/UserDetailsMenuBlade/~/RiskyUsers/userId/', UserId)
| project TimeGenerated, User, RiskLevel, RiskEventType,
          IpAddress, Location, ['Open in Entra']
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Risky sign-ins (Entra Identity Protection)
content.noDataMessage: No risky sign-ins in the window - either Identity Protection is clean, or AADUserRiskEvents is not streamed / Entra ID P2 is not licensed on this tenant.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize Failures = count(), TargetedUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress, Location = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where Failures >= 5
| where isempty('{SelectedIP}') or IPAddress =~ '{SelectedIP}'
| project IPAddress, Location, TargetedUsers, Failures, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| order by TargetedUsers desc, Failures desc
| take 100
content.title: Password-spray campaigns (failures grouped by source IP)
content.noDataMessage: No sign-in failure clusters in the window - one row per source IP; a high distinct-user count is a spray signal. (Or SigninLogs is not streamed here.)

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ClientAppUsed in ('Other clients','IMAP4','POP3','MAPI','SMTP','Exchange ActiveSync','Exchange Web Services','Authenticated SMTP','AutoDiscover','Offline Address Book')
| summarize SignIns = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by ClientAppUsed
| order by SignIns desc
content.title: Legacy-authentication sign-ins
content.noDataMessage: No legacy-auth sign-ins in the window - modern auth is enforced (or SigninLogs is not streamed to this workspace). Legacy auth bypasses MFA; block it.

content.json:
## Exposure

Internet-facing surface: public IPs, public storage, and NSGs opening sensitive ports. Each is an attack-surface and a governance finding.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses'
| extend assoc = isnotempty(tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id))
| where assoc
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize ExposedPublicIPs = count() by location, Subscription
| order by ExposedPublicIPs desc
content.title: Public IP exposure
content.noDataMessage: No associated public IP addresses in scope.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts'
| extend allowBlobPublic = tobool(properties.allowBlobPublicAccess),
         defaultAction = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction)
| where allowBlobPublic == true or defaultAction == 'Allow'
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project name, location, allowBlobPublic, defaultAction, Subscription, ResourceId = id
| take 100
content.title: Storage accounts allowing public blob access
content.noDataMessage: No storage accounts allow public blob access or open network default action.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups'
| mv-expand rule = properties.securityRules
| extend access = tostring(rule.properties.access),
         direction = tostring(rule.properties.direction),
         src = tostring(rule.properties.sourceAddressPrefix),
         dport = tostring(rule.properties.destinationPortRange),
         ruleName = tostring(rule.name)
| where access =~ 'Allow' and direction =~ 'Inbound'
| where src in ('*','0.0.0.0/0','Internet','Any')
| where dport in ('22','3389','1433','3306','5432','6379','27017') or dport == '*'
| extend PortRisk = case(dport in ('3389','22'), 3, dport == '*', 3,
                          dport in ('1433','3306','5432','6379','27017'), 2, 1)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project NSG = name, Rule = ruleName, Port = dport, Source = src,
           PortRisk, Subscription, ResourceId = id
| order by PortRisk desc, NSG asc
| take 100
content.title: NSGs allowing Internet inbound on sensitive ports
content.noDataMessage: No NSG rules expose sensitive ports (22/3389/1433/3306/5432/6379/27017) to the Internet in scope. Good - keep management ports private.

content.json:
## Privileged access

Privileged role assignments and broad Owner grants. Over-privilege is the most common path to blast-radius escalation.

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend principalType = tostring(properties.principalType),
         principalId = tostring(properties.principalId),
         scope = tostring(properties.scope)
| extend roleDefinitionId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId))
| join kind=leftouter (authorizationresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions'
    | project roleDefinitionId = tolower(id), RoleName = tostring(properties.roleName)) on roleDefinitionId
| where RoleName in ('Owner', 'User Access Administrator', 'Contributor')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project RoleName, principalType, scope, principalId, Subscription
| order by RoleName asc
| take 100
content.title: Privileged role assignments

content.json: > Privileged grants (**Owner / User Access Administrator / Contributor**) at subscription or management-group scope warrant review. Role names are resolved from role definitions; the daily posture task enriches `principalId` to a display name / UPN so reviewers see who holds the grant, not a GUID.

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend principalType = tostring(properties.principalType),
         principalId = tostring(properties.principalId),
         scope = tostring(properties.scope)
| where principalType == 'User'
| extend roleDefinitionId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId))
| join kind=leftouter (authorizationresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions'
    | project roleDefinitionId = tolower(id), RoleName = tostring(properties.roleName)) on roleDefinitionId
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project RoleName, scope, ['PrincipalId (task resolves name/UPN)'] = principalId, Subscription
| order by RoleName asc
| take 100
content.title: Guest / external accounts holding roles
content.noDataMessage: No user-principal role assignments in scope. The daily posture task flags which of these are guest (#EXT#) accounts by resolving each principal via Graph.

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend principalType = tostring(properties.principalType),
         principalId = tostring(properties.principalId),
         scope = tostring(properties.scope)
| where principalType == 'ServicePrincipal'
| extend roleDefinitionId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId))
| join kind=leftouter (authorizationresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions'
    | project roleDefinitionId = tolower(id), RoleName = tostring(properties.roleName)) on roleDefinitionId
| where RoleName in ('Owner', 'Contributor')
| where scope !contains '/resourceGroups/' or scope endswith tolower(subscriptionId)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project RoleName, scope, ['PrincipalId (task resolves SP name)'] = principalId, Subscription
| order by RoleName asc
| take 100
content.title: High-privilege service principals
content.noDataMessage: No service principals hold Owner/Contributor at subscription or management-group scope. The posture task resolves each SP's display name.

content.json:
## Expiring credentials

Key Vault secrets/certificates and Entra app-registration credentials approaching expiry (30/60/90d) - rotate before they lapse and break auth. Fed by the posture task's companion tables.

content.query:
KeyVaultCredentials_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ResourceId_s, ItemName_s
| where DaysToExpiry_d <= 90
| project Vault = VaultName_s, Type = ItemType_s, Item = ItemName_s,
          ['Days to expiry'] = DaysToExpiry_d, ExpiresOn = ExpiresOn_t,
          Subscription = Subscription_s, ResourceId = ResourceId_s
| order by ['Days to expiry'] asc
| take 200
content.title: Key Vault secrets / certificates expiring
content.noDataMessage: No Key Vault secrets/certificates expiring within 90 days (or the posture task has not yet populated KeyVaultCredentials_CL - it reads vault expiry via the data-plane where it has access).

content.query:
AppCredentials_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AppId_s, KeyId_s
| where DaysToExpiry_d <= 90
| extend ['Open in Entra'] = EvidenceLinks_s
| project Application = AppDisplayName_s, Type = CredType_s,
          ['Days to expiry'] = DaysToExpiry_d, ExpiresOn = ExpiresOn_t,
          Owner = Owner_s, ['Open in Entra']
| order by ['Days to expiry'] asc
| take 200
content.title: Entra app-registration credentials expiring
content.noDataMessage: No Entra app-registration credentials expiring within 90 days (or the posture task has not yet populated AppCredentials_CL via Microsoft Graph). Expired app secrets/certs break service-to-service auth - rotate ahead of the red band.

content.json:
## Identity lifecycle & stale-account hygiene

Stale accounts (priority matrix P0-P3), orphaned MIs, and dangling assignments - delete/disable candidates. Every proposal is recommend-only and human-gated; break-glass identities tagged `ExcludeFromLifecycle` are skipped by the task.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.managedidentity/userassignedidentities'
| extend miId = tolower(id)
| join kind=leftanti (resources
    | where isnotnull(identity.userAssignedIdentities)
    | mv-expand uami = bag_keys(identity.userAssignedIdentities)
    | project uamiId = tolower(tostring(uami))) on $left.miId == $right.uamiId
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project ['Managed identity'] = name, resourceGroup, Subscription, ResourceId = id
| order by ['Managed identity'] asc
| take 100
content.title: Orphaned user-assigned managed identities
content.noDataMessage: No orphaned user-assigned managed identities - every UAMI is attached to at least one resource. (System-assigned identities are excluded by design.)

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend principalType = tostring(properties.principalType),
         principalId = tostring(properties.principalId),
         scope = tolower(tostring(properties.scope))
| where principalType == 'ServicePrincipal'
| where scope contains '/resourcegroups/' and scope contains '/providers/'
| extend roleDefinitionId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId))
| join kind=leftouter (authorizationresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions'
    | project roleDefinitionId = tolower(id), RoleName = tostring(properties.roleName)) on roleDefinitionId
| join kind=leftanti (resources | project scope = tolower(id)) on scope
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project RoleName, scope, ['PrincipalId (task resolves name)'] = principalId, Subscription
| order by RoleName asc
| take 100
content.title: Dangling role assignments (target resource gone)
content.noDataMessage: No dangling resource-scoped role assignments detected - every assignment's target resource still exists.

content.query:
IdentityInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by PrincipalId_s
| where ExcludeFromLifecycle_b != true
| where isnotempty(Priority_s)
| where isempty('{SelectedUser}') or DisplayName_s =~ '{SelectedUser}'
| extend ['Open in Entra'] = EvidenceLinks_s
| project Priority = Priority_s, Type = PrincipalType_s, Identity = DisplayName_s,
          ['Days since sign-in'] = DaysSinceSignIn_d, ['Cred age (d)'] = CredAgeDays_d,
          Privileged = Privileged_b, Recommendation = Recommendation_s, ['Open in Entra']
| order by Priority asc, ['Days since sign-in'] desc
| take 200
content.title: Stale accounts - priority matrix (P0-P3)
content.noDataMessage: No stale accounts scored yet. The daily posture task enriches users, service principals, and managed identities (last sign-in, privilege, credential age) into IdentityInventory_CL and scores each P0-P3. P0 = privileged AND dormant AND has standing credentials. Once the task runs, ranked candidates appear here.

content.query:
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId
| extend ['Days since sign-in'] = datetime_diff('day', now(), LastSignIn) * -1
| where ['Days since sign-in'] >= 90
| project ServicePrincipal = ServicePrincipalName, LastSignIn, ['Days since sign-in']
| order by ['Days since sign-in'] desc
| take 100
content.title: Dormant service principals (no sign-in in window)
content.noDataMessage: No dormant service principals (or AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs is not streamed). The task cross-checks these against standing credentials and privilege.

content.query:
AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId
| extend ['Days since sign-in'] = datetime_diff('day', now(), LastSignIn) * -1
| where ['Days since sign-in'] >= 90
| project ['Managed identity'] = ServicePrincipalName, LastSignIn, ['Days since sign-in']
| order by ['Days since sign-in'] desc
| take 100
content.title: Dormant managed identities (no sign-in in window)
content.noDataMessage: No dormant managed identities with sign-in history (or AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs is not streamed). Orphaned MIs are covered above.

content.json:
## Change / RCA

RBAC, Conditional Access, Key Vault, and app-credential/consent changes - the config-and-identity change stream. Unexpected grants or new credentials near an incident are a strong RCA signal.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationNameValue has 'roleAssignments/write' or OperationNameValue has 'roleAssignments/delete'
| extend rdid = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(Properties)).requestbody)).Properties.RoleDefinitionId)
| extend roleGuid = tolower(extract('([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})$', 1, rdid))
| extend RoleName = case(
    roleGuid == '8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635', 'Owner',
    roleGuid == 'b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c', 'Contributor',
    roleGuid == '18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9', 'User Access Administrator',
    roleGuid == 'acdd72a7-3385-48ef-bd42-f606fbee5b42', 'Reader',
    isnotempty(roleGuid), strcat('Role ', roleGuid), 'n/a')
| where isempty('{SelectedUser}') or Caller =~ '{SelectedUser}'
| project TimeGenerated, Operation = OperationNameValue, Status = ActivityStatusValue,
          Caller, RoleName, ResourceId = _ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: RBAC change events
content.noDataMessage: No RBAC change events in the window (or AzureActivity is not streamed to this workspace).

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has 'conditional access policy'
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName,
          InitiatedBy = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
          Policy = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName), Result
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Conditional Access policy changes
content.noDataMessage: No Conditional Access policy changes in the window (or AuditLogs is not streamed). CA changes can weaken MFA/access controls - review any near an incident.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tolower(_ResourceId) has '/providers/microsoft.keyvault/vaults/'
| where OperationNameValue has 'accessPolicies' or OperationNameValue has 'vaults/write'
    or OperationNameValue has 'roleAssignments'
| project TimeGenerated, Operation = OperationNameValue, Status = ActivityStatusValue,
          Caller, ResourceId = _ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Key Vault access-policy / RBAC changes
content.noDataMessage: No Key Vault access-policy or RBAC changes in the window (or AzureActivity is not streamed). A widened vault policy is a common exfiltration precursor.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName in ('Add service principal credentials',
    'Update application - Certificates and secrets management',
    'Add app role assignment to service principal',
    'Consent to application', 'Add delegated permission grant')
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName,
          InitiatedBy = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
          Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName), Result
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: New app credentials & OAuth consent grants
content.noDataMessage: No new app credentials or OAuth consent grants in the window (or AuditLogs is not streamed). New secrets / broad consent grants are a common persistence technique.

content.json:
## Posture & secure score

Defender for Cloud posture, secure score, and Key Vault protection - the burn-down backlog behind the live signals above.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code),
         sev = tostring(properties.metadata.severity),
         display = tostring(properties.displayName)
| where status == 'Unhealthy'
| summarize Count = count() by sev, display
| order by Count desc
| take 50
content.title: Security assessments (unhealthy)
content.noDataMessage: No unhealthy Defender assessments in scope (or Defender for Cloud is not enabled).

content.json:
> **Placeholder - Secure score**
>
> Bind Defender secure score (securityresources microsoft.security/secureScores or the Defender API) for the score trend and per-control contribution.
>
> Supply the tenant-specific data source, then replace this tile with the documented query. See `docs/data-sources.md`.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults'
| extend purgeProtection = tobool(properties.enablePurgeProtection),
         softDelete = tobool(properties.enableSoftDelete)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project name, location, purgeProtection, softDelete, Subscription, ResourceId = id
| order by name asc
content.title: Key Vault protection settings
content.noDataMessage: No Key Vaults in scope.

content.json:

## Security posture at a glance

Active threat first: the **Active alert** banner and hero KPIs turn **red** on live signal. The response-health row (MTTR, aging alerts, MFA & Conditional-Access coverage) tracks how fast and how well we respond; then the Defender backlog by severity - worst first.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.severity), status = tostring(properties.status)
| where status in ('Active','InProgress')
| summarize High = countif(sev =~ 'High'), Med = countif(sev =~ 'Medium'), Total = count()
| extend Posture = case(High > 0, 'CRITICAL', Med > 0, 'DEGRADED', Total > 0, 'ELEVATED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, ['Active alerts'] = Total
content.title: Active alert posture

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code), sev = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| where status == 'Unhealthy'
| summarize High = countif(sev == 'High'), Med = countif(sev == 'Medium'), Total = count()
| extend Posture = case(High > 0, 'CRITICAL', Med > 0, 'DEGRADED', Total > 0, 'ELEVATED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, ['Unhealthy findings'] = Total
content.title: Security posture

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.severity),
         status = tostring(properties.status)
| where status in ('Active','InProgress') and sev =~ 'High'
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = 'Active critical alerts'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Active critical alerts

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups'
| mv-expand rule = properties.securityRules
| extend access = tostring(rule.properties.access),
         direction = tostring(rule.properties.direction),
         src = tostring(rule.properties.sourceAddressPrefix),
         dport = tostring(rule.properties.destinationPortRange)
| where access =~ 'Allow' and direction =~ 'Inbound'
| where src in ('*','0.0.0.0/0','Internet','Any')
| where dport in ('22','3389','1433','3306','5432','6379','27017') or dport == '*'
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = 'Open sensitive ports'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Open sensitive ports

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.managedidentity/userassignedidentities'
| extend miId = tolower(id)
| join kind=leftanti (resources
    | where isnotnull(identity.userAssignedIdentities)
    | mv-expand uami = bag_keys(identity.userAssignedIdentities)
    | project uamiId = tolower(tostring(uami))) on $left.miId == $right.uamiId
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = 'Orphaned managed identities'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Orphaned managed identities

content.query:
authorizationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments'
| extend principalType = tostring(properties.principalType)
| extend roleDefinitionId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId))
| join kind=leftouter (authorizationresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions'
    | project roleDefinitionId = tolower(id), RoleName = tostring(properties.roleName)) on roleDefinitionId
| where RoleName in ('Owner','User Access Administrator','Contributor')
| where principalType in ('ServicePrincipal','User')
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = 'Privileged SPs & users'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Privileged SPs & users

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime),
         resolved = todatetime(properties.essentials.monitorConditionResolvedDateTime),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| where cond == 'Resolved' and isnotempty(resolved)
| summarize Value = round(avg(datetime_diff('hour', resolved, fired)), 1)
| extend Metric = 'MTTR (fired->resolved)'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: MTTR (alert fired to resolved)

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition),
         fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| where cond == 'Fired' and fired < ago(4h)
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = 'Alerts open > 4h'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Active alerts open over 4h

content.query:
IdentityInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by PrincipalId_s
| where Privileged_b == true
| summarize Total = count(), Mfa = countif(MfaRegistered_b == true)
| extend Value = iff(Total == 0, 100.0, round(100.0 * Mfa / Total, 1))
| extend Metric = 'Priv MFA coverage'
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Privileged MFA coverage %
content.noDataMessage: Privileged MFA coverage appears once the posture task populates IdentityInventory_CL (privileged flag + MFA-registration).

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize Total = count(), Evaluated = countif(ConditionalAccessStatus in ('success','failure'))
| extend Value = iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Evaluated / Total, 1))

content.noDataMessage: Conditional Access coverage needs SigninLogs streamed to this workspace.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| extend status = tostring(properties.status.code), sev = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| where status == 'Unhealthy'
| summarize Findings = count() by Severity = sev
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Unhealthy findings by severity

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Security & Identity Observability" and WorkbookPage == "Security & Identity Observability"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

---
### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
